name: node callback to async/await
prompt: Create a file named read-config.ts that exports a function `readConfig(path: string, cb: (err: Error | null, data: string | null) => void)`. It MUST use the classic node-callback signature with an `(err, data)` callback — call `fs.readFile(path, 'utf8', (err, data) => cb(err, data))`. Do NOT use async/await or promises.
